summary: CHECK_KEY_IGNORE (default .harness/runs docs/plans; this repo adds docs/specs journal findings-and-research ledger) leaves literal path prefixes out of treekey's key; prompt_env exports it; check.sh's cached line names a non-default list. New tests/checks/29-check-key.sh (7 checks, 2 stub runs via STUB_EDIT). 335 → 342 green in 168 s.
verified_how: 29-check-key.sh red first (2/6: docs/plans run got 'green in 0 s'), then 7/7; bash tests/run.sh 342/342 (wall 170 s), again 342/342 with the repo's list exported as a real run would; live lib/check.sh: 'check: green in 168 s'; bash -n and node --check on every touched file; Opus review of the diff.

dead_ends.why: pipefail + grep -q's early exit SIGPIPEs git log: the check fails although the file is there; use git cat-file -e

discoveries.text: tests/lib.sh must unset every HARNESS_* variable prompt_env exports that changes check.sh's output (now HARNESS_CHECK_KEY_IGNORE too): a session's suite inherits its run's, and this repo's wide list turned the 'unset' checks red inside a real run (found by review, reproduced, fixed).

Once this merges, a session that only adds a plan, spec, decision or ledger file in this repo gets 'check: green (cached …; key ignores: docs/plans docs/specs journal findings-and-research ledger)' instead of a 3 min suite run. .harness/config.sh itself stays in the key.

STUB_EDIT=<path> in tests/stub-claude.sh: a coding session edits only that path, passes nothing, and copies the init.out it was started with to $STUB_DIR/init-<run>-<n>.out (what the pre-session suite said).

proposed_changes: P0-03 step 2 says lib/driver.sh exports HARNESS_CHECK_KEY_IGNORE; HARNESS_CHECK_CMD is exported by prompt_env in lib/prompt.sh (driver.sh's load_config calls it), so it is exported there.
questions: treekey always leaves out .harness/runs, even when CHECK_KEY_IGNORE omits it, and drops '.' entries; entries are literal (:(exclude,literal)), not globs. Keep that, or follow the spec's plain ':!<prefix>' to the letter?
